root_cause.text: The MFD core subsystem accessed and modified the global 'mfd_of_node_list' linked list without any synchronization mechanism (mutex), allowing concurrent list manipulations from different threads (e.g., device addition/removal) to cause list corruption and crashes.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a mutex (`mfd_of_node_mutex`) and wraps all list operations—in `mfd_match_of_node_to_dev`, `mfd_add_device`, and `mfd_remove_devices_fn`—within `scoped_guard(mutex, &mfd_of_node_mutex)` blocks, explicitly fixing the missing locking that was the root vulnerability.
